coverage.note: Duplicate rows/roster inconsistencies fail before analysis. Repeated userids across months are genuine coverage, not independent new persons. ESS is reported within month; no pooled ESS is presented as an independent sample size. Exclusion reasons can overlap.

controls.interpretation: Same design fitted separately to real/model/error. Difference in coefficients describes conditional under/overrepresentation, not an identified human update parameter. Leave-year ranges are sensitivity, not confidence intervals. No p-values or causal claims.

probability_shape.interpretation: Filling-style diagnostics. More nonzero bins or entropy do not prove greater real uncertainty. Raw probabilities and fitted personal IQR are separate.

q8_secondary_crosscheck.interpretation: Q8 only, additional finite <=100 and prior-point support within the Q9-common sample. No pooling Q8 and Q9, no automatic equality with the earlier Q8 evaluation support.

method: Input is the archived fitted case file, not freshly read current targets or refitted raw probabilities.
Each person-month is paired on month/userid and requires valid Q9 means/IQRs in both model repeats, finite current human Q9 mean/IQR and prior mean; exclusions retained privately.
Use design survey weight=survey weight/inclusion probability, normalized within month (or month/group). Months receive equal weight; repetitions never multiply the person count.
Compute each model repeat cell first; average its metrics within month, then average months. The model mean across repetitions is used only in the separate person regression.
Signed center bias is weighted-median model minus weighted-median human; person bias is weighted mean of paired model-human errors. Center MAE is the absolute cell median error.
Individual density IQR describes within-person uncertainty; cross-person IQR describes dispersion of fitted means. The scalar copy baseline has no copied density IQR in these inputs.
Weighted MSE equals cell mean-error squared plus cell centered-error variance. Scope MSE/components average the cell identities; MAE is not additively decomposed.
n<10 monthly group cells have support/ESS only. Reportable-month means retain missing coverage labels; no sparse cell is imputed.
Truth-defined update groups are retrospective localization. Prior level bands are exploratory.
limitations: Descriptive post-hoc A conditional historical reconstruction using actual personal priors; no causal or independent blind-test claim.
The 12 selected months are separate reconstructions, not an autonomous consecutive trajectory or a B forecast; no national prediction claim.
No uncertainty interval is inferred from 4608 generated rows; repeated people and two generations are not independent persons or independent time observations.
This analysis does not change prompts, calibration, scorer, prior outputs, or selected months.
